data.body: RP-04 epic e215 closed PROPERLY (completion-verifier: PASS, sshsig). Replaced the earlier force-closes on e215 (epic), aabf (S7) and 075b (S7.3): reopened each, added a well-shaped operator-attested 'provenance:' line to each canary AC (epic=production-equivalent/live-call; aabf+075b=narrower/live-call disclosing the op-cert SSM path was offline-oracle-only), posted detailed redacted canary-evidence comments (AWS review-bot LLM-Review+1 on Gerrit 1905/1902/1901; live Jira REB check-access 6/6 PROBE_PASS; hosted reconciler foreign pass 2026-08-19T16:34:03; bounded-live bedrock review-plan; 295 offline auth/security oracles), re-ran review-plan (PASS) + sign-review, then closed bottom-up 075b->aabf->epic through the completion gate. Epic description trimmed to 7993<8000 admission cap by shortening the epic provenance justification and dropping the satisfied Sequencing boilerplate. Filed bug a392 (cranial-sulfur-peafowl) discovered_from e215: 'reopen' lacks the parent-first cascade that claim/transition have, which allowed a closed epic with in_progress children. Bridge-config finding: jira.project=REB is NOT deprecated (absent from tombstone registry; empty projects.json is explicitly legal/backward-compatible per ADR-0097); recommended no migration.
